sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Verification status: Steam PC verification is pending. This is not a farming, value, or purchase recommendation.

The official 0.5.4 Patch Notes identify Liquid Verisium as an Expedition currency in the Runes of Aldur changes. Using it immediately starts a Runic Remnant Encounter with a random Runic Inscription. After allocating Feeling Lucky? on the Expedition Atlas Passive Tree, a player can purchase it from Farrow using Verisium. Liquid Verisium is not an Atziri's Temple currency in the cited 0.5.4 notes.

sections.title: Item verification record
bullets: Record the item name, tooltip, and stack information.
Record whether Feeling Lucky? is allocated and whether Farrow offers the purchase.
Record the Verisium cost, whether use immediately starts the encounter, and the random Runic Inscription.
Treat 0.5.4d as the recorded client version only unless a later official note lists a related fix.

sections.title: Use cases and tradeoffs
paragraphs: No use case, cost, reward, or efficiency claim is approved yet. A future verified version must state the tested context and alternatives, rather than implying that the item is universally valuable.
